subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Writes at least 3 sentences of own news or a creative story using capital letters and full stops

show.line: A sentence starts with a capital letter. It ends with a full stop. The dog ran. Big letter, little dot!

rounds.prompt: Which sentence starts with a capital letter?
rounds.praise: Yes! A big letter at the start.

rounds.prompt: What goes at the end of a sentence? Tap it.
rounds.praise: Yes! A full stop ends the sentence.

rounds.prompt: Read this sentence out loud. Stop at the full stop.
Which sentence has a full stop at the end?
rounds.praise: Yes! Mom is here. Full stop.

rounds.prompt: Names start with a capital letter too. Tap the name written the right way.
rounds.praise: Yes! Sipho starts with a big letter.

rounds.prompt: Is the sentence written right, or does it need fixing? Put each one in its group.

hints: Look at the first letter. Is it big?
Look at the end. Is there a little dot?

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will write a sentence. The cat sat.
beat_the_tutor.tutor_try: Look, I wrote it! the cat sat
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! I forgot the capital letter and the full stop.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's fix it together. Big letter at the start, dot at the end. The cat sat.

parent_line: Knows a sentence starts with a capital letter and ends with a full stop.
